provenance: Fixture data is invented and labeled illustrative; a measured source keeps the SOURCE REVIEW REQUIRED line. The provenance line is drawn inside the graphic.

purpose: An orchestrator assigning work to workers that share one state store.
use_when: Explain an orchestrator/worker pattern and the status of each worker.
not_when: Peer-to-peer agents without an orchestrator; more than four workers.
limits: Statuses are inputs. A blocked worker gets a warning-colored link.
